arxiv-2006-13032.title: Diffusion geometry of multiplex and interdependent systems
arxiv-2006-13032.creator: Giulia Bertagnolli, Manlio De Domenico
arxiv-2006-13032.description: Abstract Complex networks are characterized by latent geometries induced by their topology or by the dynamics on them. In the latter case, different network-driven processes induce distinct geometric features that can be captured by adequate metrics. Random walks, a proxy for a broad spectrum of processes, from simple contagion to metastable synchronization and consensus, have been recently used in [Phys.

arxiv-2201-09841.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Random Access in Machine-Type Communication
arxiv-2201-09841.creator: Muhammad Awais Jadoon 1 , Adriano Pastore 1 , Monica Navarro 1 , and Fernando Perez-Cruz 2
arxiv-2201-09841.description: Abstract Random access (RA) schemes are a topic of high interest in machine-type communication (MTC). In RA protocols, backoff techniques such as exponential backoff (EB) are used to stabilize the system to avoid low throughput and excessive delays. However, these backoff techniques show varying performance for different underlying assumptions and analytical models.

arxiv-2203-14632.title: Isomorphic Cross-lingual Embeddings for Low-Resource Languages
arxiv-2203-14632.creator: Sonal Sannigrahi Jesse Read
arxiv-2203-14632.description: Abstract Cross-Lingual Word Embeddings (CLWEs) are a key component to transfer linguistic information learnt from higher-resource settings into lower-resource ones. Recent research in cross-lingual representation learning has focused on offline mapping approaches due to their simplicity, computational efficacy, and ability to work with minimal parallel resources. However, they crucially depend on the assumption of embedding spaces being approximately isomorphic i.e.

arxiv-2405-07434.title: Concurrent aggregate queries
arxiv-2405-07434.creator: Gal Sela, Erez Petrank
arxiv-2405-07434.description: Abstract Concurrent data structures serve as fundamental building blocks for concurrent computing. Many concurrent counterparts have been designed for basic sequential mechanisms; however, one notable omission is a concurrent tree that supports aggregate queries. Aggregate queries essentially compile succinct information about a range of data items, for example, calculating the average salary of employees in their 30s.

arxiv-2408-14776.title: MROVSeg: Breaking the Resolution Curse of Vision-Language Models in Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentation
arxiv-2408-14776.creator: Yuanbing Zhu, Bingke Zhu, Yingying Chen, Yunfang Niu, Ming Tang, Jinqiao Wang
arxiv-2408-14776.description: Abstract Pretrained vision-language models (VLMs), e.g . CLIP, are increasingly used to bridge the gap between open- and close-vocabulary recognition in open-vocabulary image segmentation. As VLMs are generally pretrained with low-resolution images (e.g. 224 × 224 224\times 224 ), most previous methods operate only on downscaled images.

arxiv-2507-19625.title: A Catalogue of Galactic Supernova Remnants and Supernova Remnant Candidates from the EMU/POSSUM Radio Sky Surveys. I.
arxiv-2507-19625.creator: B. D. Ball, R. Kothes, E. Rosolowsky, C. Burger-Scheidlin, M. D. Filipović, S. Lazarević, Z. J. Smeaton, W. Becker, E. Carretti, B. M. Gaensler, A. M. Hopkins, D. Leahy, M. Tahani, J. L. West, C. S. Anderson, S. Loru, Y. K. Ma, N. M. McClure-Griffiths, M. J. Michałowski
arxiv-2507-19625.description: Abstract We use data from the EMU (Evolutionary Map of the Universe) and POSSUM (Polarization Sky Survey of the Universe’s Magnetism) radio southern sky surveys, conducted with the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP), to compile a catalogue of Galactic supernova remnants (SNRs) and candidate SNRs within the region of 277.5 ∘ ≤ ℓ ≤ 311.7 ∘ 277.5^{\circ}\leq\ell\leq 311.

arxiv-2512-14592.title: Probing hadronic interactions at the 100 TeV scale with the Pierre Auger Observatory
arxiv-2512-14592.description: Abstract Extensive air showers produced by the interaction of ultra-high-energy cosmic rays ( E > 1 × 10 18 eV E>$1\text{\times}{10}^{18}\text{\,}\mathrm{eV}$ ) in the Earth’s atmosphere provide a challenging yet unique channel to probe hadronic interactions at the 100 TeV 100\text{\,}\mathrm{TeV} center-of-mass energy scale.

pmc-11451280.title: Complete mitochondrial genome of Saldoida armata Horváth, 1911 (Heteroptera: Saldidae) and phylogenetic analysis
pmc-11451280.creator: Yun-Fei Wu, Xu Liu, Fan Zhang, Jia-Jia Wang
pmc-11451280.description: The complete mitochondrial genome of Saldoida armata (Heteroptera: Saldidae) is 16,049 bp in length, comprising 13 protein-coding genes (PCGs), 22 transfer RNA genes (tRNAs), 2 ribosomal RNA genes (rRNAs) and a control region. All the PCGs are initially encoded by ATN, TTG or GTG, and terminated coding with TAA or a single T.

pmc-11679107.title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning-Based Computation Offloading for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Post-Disaster Rescue
pmc-11679107.creator: Lixing Wang, Huirong Jiao
pmc-11679107.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Natural disasters cause significant losses. Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are valuable in rescue missions but need to offload tasks to edge servers due to their limited computing power and battery life. This study proposes a task offloading decision algorithm called the multi-agent deep deterministic policy gradient with cooperation and experience replay (CER-MADDPG), which is based on multi-agent reinforcement learning for UAV computation offloading. CER-MADDPG emphasizes collaboration between UAVs and uses historical UAV experiences to classify and obtain optimal strategies.

pmc-12418532.title: A novel human milk fortifier supports adequate growth in very low birth weight infants: a non-inferiority randomised controlled trial
pmc-12418532.creator: Jean-Charles Picaud, Peter Robert Reynolds, Paul Clarke, Edith van den Hooven, Mirjam M van Weissenbruch, Richard A van Lingen, Annemiek Goedhart, Akke Botma, Ralf Boettger, Elke van Westering-Kroon, Christoph Fusch, JM Hascoet, RENOIR Study Group
pmc-12418532.description: ObjectiveTo compare growth, tolerance and safety parameters in very preterm infants receiving human milk (HM) fortified with a multicomponent cow’s milk-based HM fortifier (HMF; control) versus a novel HMF-containing lipids (including docosahexaenoic acid and arachidonic acid), higher protein and lower carbohydrate levels (test).

pmc-12592476.title: Mechanism of Arp2/3 complex branch disassembly by human Coro7
pmc-12592476.creator: Nooshin Shatery Nejad, Malgorzata Boczkowska, Rouba Hilal, Fred E. Fregoso, Kyle R. Barrie, Grzegorz Rebowski, Andrew J. Saks, Alexis M. Gautreau, Enrique M. De La Cruz, Roberto Dominguez
pmc-12592476.description: Arp2/3 complex nucleates branched actin networks that drive cell motility and intracellular trafficking. Coronins, a family of seven proteins in humans, inhibit Arp2/3 complex in vitro and reduce branch density in cells. Coro7, a distant member of this family, features two β-propeller domains (β1β2) and C-terminal Central-Acidic (CA) domains and remains poorly studied.

pmc-12599842.title: Bacterial community composition, quantification of antibiotic resistance genes and antibiotic residues in wastewater treatment plant and receiving rivers
pmc-12599842.creator: Karabo Tsholo, Lesego Molale-Tom, Suranie Horn, Cornelius Carlos Bezuidenhout
pmc-12599842.description: Antibiotic resistance was, until recently, primarily documented as a clinical phenomenon, with limited consideration given to environmental settings in policymaking. Although literature has demonstrated the presence of antibiotic-resistant bacteria in water environments, there is limited information on the concentrations of antibiotic resistance genes (ARGs) and antimicrobial residues, particularly in sub-Saharan Africa.

pmc-13033314.title: Clinical Profile of Giant Cell Arteritis and Polymyalgia Rheumatica in a Tertiary Care Hospital in South India
pmc-13033314.creator: Abraham George N, Manikandan Gopal, John Mathew, Ruchika Goel, Meera Thomas
pmc-13033314.description: IntroductionThis study examines the clinical profiles of patients with giant cell arteritis (GCA) and polymyalgia rheumatica (PMR) attending a tertiary care center in South India.MethodsElectronic medical records of patients diagnosed with GCA and PMR from 2005 to 2021 were reviewed.ResultsThere were 10 patients with GCA. The mean age of the patients was 64.9 (±8) years.

pmc-13318046.title: Intimate partner violence, anxiety, stress, and depression among Israeli Arab married women in the shadow of the second wave of the COVID-19 pandemic
pmc-13318046.creator: Ola Ali-Saleh, Inbal Halevi Hochwald, Jalal Tarabeia, Fuad Basis
pmc-13318046.description: The COVID-19 pandemic was accompanied by lengthy lockdowns, school closures, and mandatory stay-at-home orders, causing stress, anxiety and depression. Since most Arabs in Israel live in closed communities in villages, with high birthrates and specific demographic characteristics, during the pandemic they may have experienced higher rates of stress, anxiety, depression, and violence against women compared to the general population.

pmc-13333081.title: Splenic Rupture: A Delayed and Rare Complication of Colonoscopy
pmc-13333081.creator: Samrudh Shaju
pmc-13333081.description: Splenic rupture is an extremely rare but significant complication of colonoscopy with a high mortality rate. Most patients present within 24 to 48 hours post-procedure with abdominal pain, hypotension, and/or syncope. This case report highlights the rare case of a patient presenting nine days post-procedure with splenic rupture.

pmc-13360647.title: Ultrasensitive Detection of Neurofilament Light in Plasma Using F(Ab’)2‐Modified Graphene Field‐Effect Biosensor
pmc-13360647.creator: Selvinaz Burcu Kizilates, Rica Asrosa, Lenart Senicar, Anuja Sharma, Seda Gungordu Er, Nisha Naeem, Ahmad Nizamuddin bin Muhammad Mustafa, Yang Wu, Neil Graham, Amanda Heslegrave, Mohan Edirisinghe, Antonio Lombardo, Elias Torres, Henrik Zetterberg, Sami Ramadan, David J. Sharp, Bing Li
pmc-13360647.description: Neurofilament light (NfL) is a discriminative blood biomarker for many neurological diseases. Current accurate analysis relating to NfL relies on state‐of‐the‐art technologies such as the single‐molecule array (Simoa) and immunoprecipitation‐mass spectrometry (IP‐MS), which require complicated machinery, skilled operational personnel, and well‐equipped laboratories. Herein, we demonstrate a robust on‐chip graphene field‐effect transistor (GFET) biosensing platform for the ultrasensitive detection of NfL.

pmc-13366173.title: Residual metal single-atom catalysis: enhanced photocatalytic hydrogen production via ligand-modulated d-orbital splitting
pmc-13366173.creator: Kun Tang, Qi Zhao, Jin-Yue Guo, Bing-Bao Mei, Chang He, Jiang-Yang Shao, Zailai Xie, Jiannian Yao, Yu-Wu Zhong
pmc-13366173.description: This study demonstrates that residual palladium (Pd) species, often considered unintended impurities in organic photocatalysts, can function as highly efficient catalytic sites when atomically dispersed and strategically coordinated within molecular frameworks. A series of pyridine-terminated organic small molecules are synthesized to anchor Pd single atoms via monodentate coordination, which significantly modulates the electronic structure and catalytic behavior.

pmc-13457565.creator: Matthias Carstens, Shubha Vasisht, Zheyuan Zhang, Iulia Barbur, Annika Reinke, Lena Maier-Hein, Daniel A. Hashimoto, Fiona R. Kolbinger
pmc-13457565.description: In this reply to MacAonghusa and Cahill, we reflect on fundamental validation challenges in AI-enabled surgical scene understanding and propose key priorities that academic, clinical, and industry stakeholders must collaboratively address to achieve safe and impactful clinical translation of surgical video AI: First, tying descriptive analytics to outcomes that matter to patients or surgical teams, second, establishing longitudinal, multimodal, and

pmc-13637194.title: Effectiveness of vitamin C and D supplementation as an adjunct in the management of gingivitis in school-going children: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-13637194.creator: Arooj ul Hassan, Asif Hanif, Muhammad Hassan, Obaid Bajwa, Muhammad Anas, Muhammad Sohail Zafar
pmc-13637194.description: BackgroundGingival diseases in Pakistan rank among the nation’s foremost oral health issues. Vitamins C and D may influence gingival health through collagen metabolism and immune regulation.ObjectiveThe study aimed to assess whether vitamin C and D supplementation can reduce bleeding on probing (BOP), measured as the percentage of bleeding sites (BOP%).
